h2: Ultrasonic thickness measurement course content in UT Level 1
html:
A large share of UT Level 1 work in the US is thickness measurement: corrosion surveys on piping, vessels and tanks in owners' inspection programmes, and wall checks on castings and plate. If what you need is an ultrasonic thickness measurement course, UT Level 1 is the course that covers it, and its hours count toward Level I certification.

What the thickness part of the course teaches

  • How a pulse-echo measurement works: sound velocity, time of flight, and why a wrong velocity gives a wrong reading at every point.
  • Dual-element and single-element probes, and why dual-element probes are the standard on corroded surfaces.
  • Calibration on a step wedge of the same material, two-point calibration and probe zero, and checking calibration through the shift.
  • Echo-to-echo measurement through paint and coatings, and its limits.
  • High-temperature measurement, couplant choice and the change of velocity with temperature.
  • Pitting, and why a spot reading can miss the minimum, which is where corrosion mapping and scanning take over.
  • Recording readings against condition monitoring locations so the owner can calculate corrosion rates.

Standards behind UT thickness gauging

The usual reference for UT thickness gauging is ASTM E797, which ASME Section V reproduces as SE-797, with the owner's procedure and inspection code setting where and how often to measure. Corrosion-rate and remaining-life calculations belong to the inspector and the engineer, not the Level I, but a Level I who understands them records better data; the ultrasonic thickness calculator shows how readings become a rate.

What Level 1 adds beyond thickness

The full course also covers shear-wave basics, angle-beam probes and reference reflectors, so you can assist on weld examination and move on to UT Level 2, where flaw sizing and acceptance decisions begin. If your job only needs thickness gauging, say so when you enrol: SNT-TC-1A allows an employer to define a limited certification for a specific task such as thickness measurement, with training and experience to match.

How it is delivered

Theory is self-paced online with ASNT NDT Level III support, and the practical is done in the Practical NDT simulator and on real equipment at your employer's site. See every level of ultrasonic testing training, or ask about a course.
